source_url: https://mqa-internet.doh.state.fl.us/MQASearchServices/HealthCareProviders (Profession=1711 'Advanced Practice Registered Nurse'; matches accepted only when the license's Qualifications list includes 'Certified Nurse Midwife')
source_dataset: Florida DOH Division of Medical Quality Assurance, License Verification (mqa-internet.doh.state.fl.us)
match_method: last_name + first_name search under the APRN profession code; Florida has no separate CNM profession category, so a match is accepted only when the license's own Qualifications field lists 'Certified Nurse Midwife' -- an APRN name match that is NOT so qualified is reported NOT_CNM_QUALIFIED, not counted as a midwife; more than one CNM-qualified candidate sharing a name is AMBIGUOUS
